slices.focus: Initial comprehensive life disclosure: identity, values, career goal of ferry terminal resilience, and the family roots of that commitment.
slices.summary: Ayaka introduces herself fully — name, age, ISFJ personality, Regional Planning background, and her five-year goal to make Hakata Island Ferry Terminal resilient during bad-weather stretches. She describes her grandparents on Shikanoshima, her sister in Osaka, mentor Mori Chisato, friend Nozomi, coworker Sakurai Kenta, her terminal work, and the deep connection between reliable service and island household trust.
